search_terms_used: Junior Lawyer Legal Counsel In-House Counsel

dominant_barriers: Arabic language requirement is the single biggest barrier – approximately 40% of junior/mid legal roles in Dubai require Arabic as mandatory
UAE-specific legal experience is commonly required even for junior roles (1-3 years UAE PQE)
Many law firm roles require UK, Australian, Egyptian, or GCC-qualified lawyers
Salary ranges for genuine junior legal roles frequently fall below AED 8,000 (AED 3,500–7,000 observed)
Most roles meeting salary threshold are senior level (5+ years PQE, Senior Associate, Head of Legal, Partner)
market_observations.recommendation: The Indeed UAE legal market as of June 2026 presents very limited options for Tanya's profile. Suggest supplementing Indeed with direct law firm applications (magic circle / silver circle firms with Dubai offices), legal recruitment agencies specializing in UAE placements (Cooper Fitch, Michael Page Legal, Robert Half Legal UAE), and LinkedIn job search targeting international companies with DIFC/ADGM offices that may not require Arabic.
